# GuardedStruct v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

> Build Elixir structs with validation, sanitization, nested sub-structs, conditional fields, pattern-keyed maps, and an Ash extension. Built on Spark.

## Modules

- [GuardedStruct.AshResource.Change](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.AshResource.Change.md): An `Ash.Resource.Change` module that plugs `__guarded_change__/1` into the
Ash changeset pipeline.
- [GuardedStruct.Diff](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Diff.md): Field-level diffs between two GuardedStruct instances.
- [GuardedStruct.Helper.Extra](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Helper.Extra.md)
- [GuardedStruct.Derive.SanitizerDerive](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Derive.SanitizerDerive.md): Built-in sanitizer ops. Every clause follows the pipe-friendly
`sanitize(value, op)` argument order
- [GuardedStruct.Derive.ValidationDerive](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Derive.ValidationDerive.md)

- Core
  - [GuardedStruct](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.md): GuardedStruct macro: build structs with validation, sanitization, constructors,
and nested-struct support.
  - [GuardedStruct.Info](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Info.md): Runtime introspection of guardedstruct DSL state.

- Validation
  - [GuardedStruct.Validate](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Validate.md): Standalone validators that reuse a `GuardedStruct` schema without going
through the full `builder/1` pipeline.

- Errors (Splode)
  - [GuardedStruct.Errors](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Errors.md): Splode error aggregator for GuardedStruct runtime errors.
  - [GuardedStruct.Errors.Validation](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Errors.Validation.md): Single field-level validation error.

- Extensions
  - [GuardedStruct.AshResource](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.AshResource.md): A Spark DSL extension that adds the GuardedStruct DSL to an Ash resource.
  - [GuardedStruct.AshResource.Info](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.AshResource.Info.md): Runtime introspection for the `GuardedStruct.AshResource` extension.
  - [GuardedStruct.Derive.Extension](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Derive.Extension.md): Define custom derive validators / sanitizers via a Spark DSL.

- i18n
  - [GuardedStruct.Messages](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/GuardedStruct.Messages.md): This module is used to define the messages that are used in the guarded_struct library.
You can define your own messages by creating a module that uses this module and
implements the callbacks defined in this module.
It can be used to define messages in multiple languages like using Gettext.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix guarded_struct.install](https://guarded-struct.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.GuardedStruct.Install.md): One-command project setup for guarded_struct
